entries.subject: B1-10 carrier scope conflict
entries.text: The FROZEN B1-10 contract requires one test class to exercise POST /login and POST /login/resolve through the real HTTP surface. WORKER.md permits reading only B1-10 integration/acceptance tests and minimum harness support, while the permitted files expose only PostgreSQL fixtures and direct-SQL session tests; they do not expose the existing login/resolve wiring or an HTTP test harness. Please authorize the minimum named production API/harness files needed for that test, or explicitly authorize a database-only scenario with PA-7/HTTP behavior marked unproven.

entries.subject: B1-10 HTTP harness scope
entries.text: PO decision: implement the real HTTP scenario, not a database-only substitute. Permitted additional reads/changes: LoginController, LoginResolveController, session/auth composition wiring, SecurityWebMvcConfig, and the minimum existing HTTP test harness/configuration files required to exercise POST /login and POST /login/resolve against one service instance. No production behavior change unless a test seam is strictly required; report any such change. Keep scope to B1-10 concurrent isolation/correlation acceptance.

entries.subject: B1-10 scope contradiction
entries.text: The FROZEN B1-10 contract specifies only a three-admin session/correlation HTTP scenario (PA-1 through PA-7). The dispatch acceptance criteria instead require unrelated Workbench draft-loss/switch-leakage, stopped classification/count, unknown/estimated labels, and keyboard behavior. These scopes cannot both govern this test-only movement. Please identify the authoritative acceptance criteria.

entries.subject: B1-10 authoritative acceptance criteria
entries.text: Correction: only UI2_0_B1_10_ACCEPTANCE_CONCURRENT_ADMINS_CONTRACT.md PA-1 through PA-7 govern this movement. Workbench draft/classification/cost/keyboard criteria are entirely out of scope and belong to NXS-LOCAL-0251. Implement the three-admin HTTP session/correlation scenario only.

entries.subject: B1-10 cannot pass without production behavior change
entries.text: Verified the permitted real HTTP/session composition. The frozen PA-2 and PA-5 cannot pass against current behavior: LoginFlow/JooqSessionRepository do not supply correlation_run_id to the audited takeover transaction, so its two audit rows are NULL; and the available real session-status HTTP endpoint returns 401 {authenticated:false} for S1 rather than the required 401 SESSION_SUPERSEDED. A test-only harness cannot truthfully alter either behavior. Please authorize the minimal production implementation needed for PA-2/PA-5 (and confirm the intended E1 HTTP endpoint for PA-5), or revise the frozen scenario/acceptance target.
